# volcenginecc_cloudmonitor_alert_template (Data Source)

Data Source schema for Volcengine::CloudMonitor::AlertTemplate

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `applied_project_name` (String) Project name where the alert template has been applied, returned by the service side

- `description` (String) Alert template description
- `name` (String) Alert template name

- `silence_time` (Number) Silence period (minutes)
- `template_id` (String) Alert template ID
- `template_rules` (Attributes List) Alert template rule list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--template_rules))
